name: Encainide

own_problems.text: Pulled from the market in United States and United Kingdom, first in 1991 — for heart harm

similar.name: Thioridazine
problems: Pulled from the market worldwide, first in 2005 — for heart harm
Carries a boxed warning in United States — for heart harm and higher risk of infection

summary: Encainide was taken off the market in the United States and the United Kingdom starting in 1991 due to heart harm [3]. A small computer model, rather than tests on people, calculated a medium risk score of 51 for the liver and a low risk score of 44 for the heart [M]. A similar medicine called Thioridazine was removed from the worldwide market for heart harm and holds strong warnings for heart harm and infectious disease [4].
